piece.headline: Cherag's bench bites as the crown changes hands
piece.standfirst: Haaland blanked for 21 captains, Dominic won the week with 75, and the title lead changed hands again.
piece.big_picture: Cherag's long reign at the top is over. Ayodele takes the crown, 8 clear. The crown has now changed hands 4 times this season, so nobody should get comfy. Sid is third, 29 off the pace.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Hishaan captained Barry instead of Haaland. 32 with the armband against 4 for the Haaland crowd, a 28-point swing. Nobody else dared. Nerve first, then a worldie.
piece.one_to_watch: Ayodele against Cherag again. If Gakpo starts repaying the transfer, Ayodele could stretch clear. If Cherag sorts the bench, the lead could flip straight back.

winners.name: Dominic
winners.verdict: Started Trafford alone and he returned 10. A brave punt, and the climb up from 24th is turning into a proper recovery.

winners.name: Maanav
winners.verdict: 4 weeks of creeping off the bottom, and now up to 19th. Not a fluke. Skill, quietly applied.

losers.name: Cherag
losers.verdict: 24 points on the bench in the week the lead went. That is the Bench Disaster award, and it was earned.

losers.name: IB
losers.verdict: Bottom again after a tough spell. Elvin is only 7 points ahead, so one decent week could change the picture.

losers.name: Ravi
losers.verdict: The worst week of the season, and down to 13th. Bad luck stopped being the excuse a while ago.
